title: Weekly Report
description: The §4 weekly-report document. One report = one meeting with one champion, covering all their domains. This same schema does three jobs: form layout, save-time validation, and the contract the LLM drafts notes against.

raw_notes.description: The raw meeting notes pasted verbatim; kept inside the report.

domainSection.description: One domain's slice. `domain` is an EXISTING domain name used only for placement; the report never creates domains nor carries per-domain attribute changes.

taskEntry.description: A task line. `id` is the match signal: when the line matches an existing context task, return that task's id together with its exact existing name in `task`; for a new task (no match, or notes say "new …") omit `id` (null) and give the free-text name.

id.description: PK of the matched existing task from the context; null/omitted for a new task.

finished_on.description: Optional per-task finish-date override (YYYY-MM-DD). When the task reaches a terminal status, ended_on is set to this value if present, otherwise to the report's meeting_date. The engine never auto-computes ended_on from status history.

artifactEntry.description: An artifact change line. `id` is the match signal: when the line matches an existing context artifact, return that artifact's id together with its exact existing name in `artifact` and its `type`; for a new artifact (no match, or notes say "new …") omit `id` (null), give the free-text name and a best-fit `type`.

id.description: PK of the matched existing artifact from the context; null/omitted for a new artifact.
